# Re-installed from package-lock.json on every machine / CI run.
node_modules/

# ── build output ───────────────────────────────
# Regenerated by `next build` and `next export` — never versioned.
.next/
out/

# ── secrets ────────────────────────────────────
# Local env files must never be committed or uploaded anywhere.
.env*.local

# ── misc ───────────────────────────────────────
npm-debug.log*
*.tsbuildinfo
.DS_Store
